# Fixtures

Real SS.com list and detail pages saved by `tools/probe` on 2026-09-25,
copied verbatim so `parseList` / `parseDetail` are tested against the exact
markup the site served. They contain third-party advertisement text and
server-masked phone numbers. **Local test data only: never publish, never
commit to a public remote, never quote in docs.** See `scraper/.gitignore`.
